basic_profile.bio: I'm a Jacksonville native who loves exploring the hidden gems of my city. I'm in my late 30s, working as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my love for local history and nature trails. I'm passionate about craft beer, retro video games, and spend weekends at local markets or hiking. I have a partner of 5 years, and we enjoy discovering new places together. Typically online in the evenings, after 7 PM. Occasionally, you'll find me moderating a few local subreddits.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having lived in Jacksonville all my life, my knowledge of the city comes from personal experiences and a deep love for its culture and history. My educational background in design fuels my creativity, while my interest in technology keeps me updated with the latest trends in graphic design and digital marketing.
